shared_elements: possible curvilinear/spiral or circular motifs (A, eroded)
justification: B shows a clearly organised figural scene in two registers with standing human figures in profile, raised arms in gesture, offering stands and sign-like glyphs, whereas A shows only faint, eroded pecked marks and possible circular hollows on an irregular boulder with no discernible figures or composition. The only correspondence is that both are shallow carvings on rock with vaguely rounded motifs, which is far too generic to indicate any shared iconographic scheme.
